entries.name: TEST_Dazzled
entries.text:
TEST_Dazzled
• A dazzled creature has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
• Attack rolls against the creature have advantage if the attacker is more than 30 feet away.

entries.name: TEST_Marching Order
entries.text:
TEST_Marching Order
The adventurers should establish a marching order. A marching order makes it easier to determine which characters are affected by traps, which ones can spot hidden enemies, and which ones are the closest to those enemies when a fight breaks out. The party’s order can be split into a front rank, a middle rank and a back rank.

Travel Pace
Pace Distance per Hour Effect
Fast 4 miles –5 penalty to passive Wisdom (Perception) scores
Normal 3 miles —
Slow 2 miles Able to use stealth

entries.name: TEST_Rust Fever
entries.text:
TEST_Rust Fever
This disease spreads through the bite of rust-coloured mites. A creature exposed to it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become infected. Symptoms appear 1d4 days after infection.
